applications.name: Amara Okoye
experience: Rebuilt a payments service in Python and FastAPI, cutting p95 latency from 820ms to 190ms.
Ran the Kubernetes migration for 14 services and codified the platform in Terraform.
Tuned PostgreSQL query plans and introduced SQLAlchemy connection pooling under peak load.
Mentored two junior engineers for 18 months and led code review for the platform guild.
Held the on-call pager for the payments tier and wrote the postmortem for the June outage.
applications.personal_statement: My name is Amara Okoye. I graduated from University of Lagos in 2012 and I have spent eleven years building payment platforms.

applications.personal_statement: Hi, I am Jonas Lindgren, a backend engineer who studied at KTH Royal Institute of Technology and graduated in 2009.
